name: Gconnect Logitech & Supply Chain Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2022, Gconnect Logitech 
& Supply Chain Ltd provides logistics and 
 supply chain services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GLSCL provides surface logistics services, viz. goods transport services, mainly in Gujarat. It offers its services to other logistic  companies, including surface logistic companies, and to direct customers.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.72 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -7.58%
Company has high debtors of 206 days.
